name: bensondevs/supercharged-enums
description: Supercharged backed enum helpers (find, options, comparisons) with no framework dependencies.

suggest.illuminate/console: Required for the import-from-table Artisan command.
suggest.illuminate/database: Required for SuperchargedEnumCast, EnumExtensionCollectionCast, SuperchargedEnumArrayCast Eloquent casting, and the import-from-table Artisan command.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required for collect() and Laravel stub publishing (included in all Laravel apps).
